slot_note: new number in wave 7 (Root-Cause), numbered from seed RC05 (a regional electricity distributor choosing one reliability programme from five, the costliest cause leaving no record of its own). Architecture 1 (Quantitative Finance) was spent at the draw in task398's cell; architecture 2 (a bus operator's drivers' rest) was spent at the draw as a template of shipped task121 v6. Architecture 3 keeps the decision (one programme funded from a catalogue of five) and the seed's kernel (a cost that leaves no record of its own: a search that found no test slot leaves no trace of the shortage) in Product Analytics.
niche: a provincial licensing agency's online road-test booking service, whose new drivers licensed fell in the twelve months to 30 September 2026: where in the journey from permit to licence the fall came from, and which of five 2027 initiatives the agency funds (the portal's booking redesign, more examiner shifts, a hazard-perception practice module, a fee rebate, no-show reminders)
analyst_test: A strong analyst who builds the permit-to-licence funnel stage by stage, compares each stage's rate year on year and segments it by the portal release, device and test centre funds the booking redesign, because the search-to-booking stage carries the largest fall and the fall lines up with the March 2026 release; the scheduling system's slot releases, bookings and cancellations show the searches failed because no slot was open within the six weeks the portal shows, and only the examiner shifts initiative removes that.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each funnel stage's loss of candidates against the prior year, read the way funnel and journey analysis reads it (stage volumes, conversion rates and time between steps), where the stage that shows the loss is not the stage that causes it because a capacity behind the portal empties; with a hospital's referral pathway in place of the booking journey the same capacity reading would hold, but with a reading score or a megawatt-hour there is no journey, no stage and no stock of slots to run out.

spine.entity: one slot search run on the road-test booking portal

world.geography: Canada (a fictional province, its licensing agency and its test centres)
world.org_type: a provincial driver licensing agency running road-test centres

driver: The decisive quantity is the stock of a capacity that sits behind a self-service journey, rebuilt day by day from its own releases, bookings and returns: where the stock is empty the journey's searches fail without any record of the shortage, so a stage-by-stage reading puts the fall on the step where users gave up and on the release that changed that step, while read against the stock open at each search the step is sound and the candidate that adds capacity is the largest.
driver_concrete: Norland's portal shows only slots within six weeks; from spring 2026 examiner shifts fell behind the permit holders reaching test eligibility, the slot stock at most centres sat empty for days at a time, and permit holders searched, found nothing and left; the portal logs the search and no booking, the scheduling system logs the slot releases, bookings and cancellations, and only the stock rebuilt from those shows that the search-to-booking fall is the examiners' and not the March 2026 booking redesign's.
stump: A competent solver builds the permit-to-licence funnel, finds the search-to-booking stage carries the largest fall and that it lines up with the March 2026 booking redesign, and funds the redesign; the step that lands it there is reading the stage's loss as the portal's, when the scheduling system's releases, bookings and cancellations show no slot open within six weeks at the centre searched for most of the failed searches, which puts the fall on examiner capacity.

differentiation.task121: task121 v4 measures a satisfaction fall on the journey conditions (delays, crowding) each respondent travelled under, a driver analysis of ratings; task399 has no ratings and no ambient conditions: it rebuilds a stock (open road-test slots per centre and day) from the scheduling system's releases, bookings and cancellations and shows a funnel stage's loss happened where the stock was empty, so the stage that shows the loss is not its cause.
differentiation.task307: task307 sizes what added capacity saves across a network whose users re-choose their paths; task399 sizes nothing forward: it finds that a closed year's funnel loss sat behind an empty capacity stock that the funnel's own log cannot see.
differentiation.task254: task254 times units through a fixed sequence of stages; task399 reads no stage durations: the decisive record is a stock rebuilt from releases and bookings, set against each search's centre and window.

lineage.architecture: v1 (Quantitative Finance: a manufacturer's pension plan's global equity programme, which of five initiatives to fund against the shortfall to its policy benchmark)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the money a parent raised for its own payments and left waiting in one unit's account, recorded there as the unit's holding: a unit-level attribution books its cost to the unit as a low market exposure and credits the candidate that would keep that money invested with almost nothing, while the money's own path puts it with the parent and makes that candidate the largest.
lineage.fate: spent at the draw on 2026-11-03: it collided with task398's draw in the same cell (quantitative-finance / factor-return-attribution / root-cause), registered earlier but not visible to this guard; guard.py check with task398 visible returned BLOCK ban.pairing, ban.subdomain, ban.artifact (filed_standard) and ban.strategy (decomposition_attribution), and a reviewer would read the two as the same decision (an equity programme's shortfall against its benchmark and which of five changes removes most of it)

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the rest a worker actually got, rebuilt from the operation's own event record rather than from the schedule: running late, the operation works straight through the scheduled rests, so a schedule-based fatigue analysis puts the rising risk on long shifts and the candidate that would restore the rests looks worth nothing, while measured on the rest actually taken the long-shift effect vanishes and that candidate is the largest.
lineage.architecture: v2 (Human Factors: a regional bus operator, drivers safety events against the terminus stands the schedule promised)
lineage.fate: spent at the draw on 2026-11-03: same cell and same decisive insight as shipped task121 v6 (rest rebuilt from the operator records), a template the lexical guard misses (driver score 0.06); nine axes equal to task121 (domain, subdomain, objective, shape 18, gate_g, strategy, decision type, question form what, org family)
